# Audio sources

## Audio pass five: cutter release

Runtime envelope/pitch changes separate the cutter rotor wind-down from contact
release; the same physical-v4 recordings and their licences below remain in use.
No new recorded assets were added.

## Audio pass four: physical-v4

The shipped `physical-v4/*.ogg` are edited/layered recordings, with exact cuts,
source hashes, filters and output hashes in `physical-v4/edits.json`. Raw packs
remain outside the game at G:/sfx/raw-packs. `tools/prepare-physical-pass4.mjs`
reproduces these edits. Source licences continue to apply to the edited audio:

- Sonniss GDC 2020 free bundle: Pole Position, The Junkyard Metal Library and
  The Ironwork Machinery Library; Coll Anderson, Metal Movement; Stefano Cremona,
  Explosions. Royalty-free commercial game use/modification, no attribution required;
  this is **not CC0**. Downloaded 2026-10-10 under the current GDC bundle licence v2:
  https://sonniss.com/gdc-bundle-license/ . Primary collection:
  https://sonniss.com/gameaudiogdc/ . Every selected file matches the official GDC
  2020 tracklist linked there. No standalone sample-pack redistribution or AI
  training/development. Recordings provide boost/hull stress, drive pressure,
  metallic mechanisms, gun body and rockfall/blast tails.
- Michael Brigida and students: 12 Ambient Machine Sounds, selected/prepared for
  OLPC by Dr. Richard Boulanger, recorded in Berklee Studios and around Boston by
  Music Synthesis students; original editing/trimming by Diane Douglas and Colman
  O'Reilly. CC-BY 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ . Source:
  https://opengameart.org/content/12-ambient-machine-sounds . `Engine noise.wav`,
  `dryer1.wav`, `debris_1.wav` are cropped, filtered, levelled, loop-spliced and
  layered with authored drive/rotor/sub-pressure sound design here. These provide
  drive-core, cutter-rotor/contact and rock-chip variations.
- BMacZero: Metal Impact Sounds, `thud3.wav`, CC0 1.0. Source:
  https://opengameart.org/content/metal-impact-sounds . Cropped/filtered/levelled
  for metal-hit-2. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ .

Original authored harmonic/body layers and runtime synthesis are dedicated under
CC0-1.0. That dedication covers our authored work only; all modified recordings
above retain their own source licences. Native gun identities, human/creature
voices, score, narration and their existing provenance remain credited below.

## Audio pass three

Original human breath/formant, mechanical failure and creature hurt/attack/death
layers in `encounterAudio.ts` have four independently authored procedural takes
per family and reaction. Licensed recorded human voices remain the primary layer.
The new warm harmonic texture and sparse exploration motif in `motionAudio.ts`
are original compositions with world transposition and four-phrase variation.
These new authored layers are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . No external recordings or
model-generated assets were added. Existing briefing Ogg provenance is unchanged;
its media now plays through the game master, mute and limiter graph.

## Audio pass two

Original runtime synthesis in `src/core/encounterAudio.ts` adds four independent
takes per creature family and state (growls, insect stridulation, filtered robot
commands without speech), plus small alternating UI contacts. Original stereo
reflection/noise impulse responses in `src/core/acousticSpace.ts` provide cave
and outdoor reverberation; neither uses recordings or downloaded impulse files.
These new authored sounds are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ .
Source buffers are bounded and generated locally in WebAudio; existing asset
licenses remain intact. No external AI generation or copyrighted game/film audio.

## October 9 audio/v1 motion and adaptive score

`src/core/motionAudio.ts` contains original procedural sound design created for
Unlit Worlds: engine ignition and boost pressure, throttle air/machinery wash,
quiet ship cabin ventilation, cutter spindle/contact grit, varied rock chips
and collapse debris, and a four-bar combat percussion layer. These are generated
directly into bounded WebAudio buffers; no external recordings, samples, model
outputs, copyrighted game or film audio, or additional downloaded assets are used.
The implementation is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ .

Existing compressed Ogg recordings and streamed music retain the credits and
licenses below. The recorded ship and weapon identities remain in the mix. The
new percussion follows the music volume and ducking path; machinery, ambience
and rock contacts follow their respective mixer channels. Runtime source:
`src/core/motionAudio.ts`; validation: `tools/test-audio-v1.mjs`.

The primary gun, ship-weapon, missile, explosion, armor-hit and ballistic-reload
bank is now `physical-v1/`: 67 edited CC0 recording-based effects. Firearm reports
come from the Free Firearm Sound Library; reload actions from SpringySpringo;
launch motors, blast debris and metal contacts from Kenney, credited below.
Four recorded variations per weapon cycle independently of footsteps and impacts.
Low-mid pressure and quiet mechanical layers are baked into each mono file.
There are no Expanse recordings or extracted show assets. The tonal reference is
physical machinery and ballistic reports, not synthesized pitched laser chirps.
Edits and source cut positions: `tools/prepare-physical-weapons.mjs` and

# Contextual synthwave and new gun recordings — September 11, 2026

`context/*.ogg`: generated locally with Stability AI Stable Audio 3 `small-music` (12 instrumental location/combat themes) and `small-sfx` (five arrival cues, 20 weapon takes). Generation uses reproducible seeds and eight inference steps. Production edits trim reports, control tails, normalize levels with codec headroom and crossfade music loop boundaries. Prompts, seeds and file hashes: `reports/context-audio/assets.json`; generator: `tools/generate-context-audio.py`.

## ACE B production bank — September 11, 2026

`production/*.ogg`: twelve ACE-Step 1.5 XL SFT location/combat scores and 99 Stable Audio 3 Medium effects/arrival cues. Space exploration is conditioned on the approved original ACE B audition. Music receives broad low-mid EQ, level adjustment and a loop-boundary crossfade. Effects are edited into bounded mono one-shots and smooth machinery loops. Existing environmental ambience is preserved.

Exact model settings, prompts, seeds, batch indices, processing and SHA-256 hashes: `reports/context-audio/production-music.json` and `production-sfx.json`. Sources: https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-sft and https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-audio-3-medium. The model licenses apply to their weights; original fallback recording credits above remain intact.

## September 12 revisions

Dungeon exploration: The Stone Remembers, original instrumental generated locally with ACE-Step v1.5 XL SFT. Three-second loop overlap and exploration loudness normalization. Brief and provenance: reports/combat-introduction/dungeon-music.json.

New-game briefing: original game text, synthesized locally with Microsoft Windows Speech (David). Recorded narration with matching on-screen transcript, replay, mute support and skip.

## Human reactions

`reactions-v1/humanHurt-*.ogg` and `reactions-v1/humanDeath-*.ogg`: HaelDB, Male grunt/yelling sounds, offered under CC0. Source: https://opengameart.org/content/male-gruntyelling-sounds . Edited with silence trimming, band limiting, mono conversion and loudness normalization. Source take names and output hashes are recorded in reports/piracy/combat-audio/assets.json.

## October 4 field Foley and mixer

`field-v2/`: four layered variations per frequent UI, mechanical, footstep, impact, debris and warning sound, plus four engine loops. Every output's source filenames, edit and licence are listed in [field-v2/sources.json](field-v2/sources.json). All source recordings are CC0-1.0:

- Kenney Interface Sounds: https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
- Kenney Impact Sounds: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
- Kenney Sci-fi Sounds: https://kenney.nl/assets/sci-fi-sounds
- Free Firearm Sound Library and SpringySpringo Gun Reload Sounds, credited above.

Baked with `tools/assets/prepare-field-audio.mjs`: mono 48 kHz, short tactile attacks, filtered pressure/debris/mechanism layers, fades and codec headroom; engine loops crossfade. No new model-generated material. Existing ambient recordings and music retain their original credits. Runtime varies takes, pitch and level, applies distance filtering, and exposes independent weapon, impact, engine, ambience, UI and alert levels.

eventVariation.roundRobin: Full shuffled bag, every take once before refill; boundary swap prevents immediate last-take repetition. UI and score unchanged.
eventVariation.bakedLayerSelection: All20 families have8 unique takes and >=2 actual source-layer combinations. PDC layer selection is baked, never stacked. V7 seven guided phase/motor families also each8 unique physical takes and >=2 actual source-layer combinations.

spatialPolicy.sizeUnits: game hull length; unitsToCentimeters100 applies native distances
spatialPolicy.PDCSizeModulation: fixed30 to preserve calibrated short burst weight

guidedMotorPolicy.lifetime: Start once for nearest active motor per objectID+guidedGeneration. Cold launch, coasting, done, launchPending, remote, map-open and pause silence it. Stop/fade200ms when source ends; pooled generation starts new variant.
guidedMotorPolicy.filter: missile/swarm390+closing460 / torpedo280+closing390, times randomFilter*sizeFilter, capped by distanceLowpass

damageObservation.breach: Observe new real hull breach count; do not replay restored-save breaches on startup. No damage changes.
damageObservation.vent: At most2 nearest damaged breached hulls; finite1.8s releases, gated1.8s per hull; no per-particle sounds.

guidedPhasePolicy.dedup: Audio-owned WeakMap keyed object identity plus guidedGeneration; first cold release and first ignition only. Coast correction never replays ignition. Old flying objects discovered from load/view do not invent launch reports. Consume remote/paused transitions without delayed replay. Callback timing authoritative;100ms observer fallback supports older callbackless bodies.
guidedPhasePolicy.lifetime: Cold/ignite are finite one-shots at actual phase. Pause/map/remote retire phase voices18ms. Motors stop/fade200ms on coast/done/remote/map/pause. Never simulate alignment or manipulate missile state.

swarmWallPolicy.position: centroid of actually burning local swarm bodies within1000
swarmWallPolicy.stop: fewer than3 active local burns, coast, done, remote, map or pause; fade40ms/stop200ms
swarmWallPolicy.loopContract: Spawn once, update bounded density/pan/filter, retain native component while burning, stop on lifetime end. Score transport unchanged.

# HARD BURN audio credits

The naval score, shipboard machinery and four variants of rail, MAC, PDC, flak,
armour, heavy breakup and launch sounds in `naval/` are original deterministic
synthesis by HARD BURN original audio. They are dedicated to the public domain
under **CC0-1.0**: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.
`naval/sources.json` records each asset, its duration and provenance.
`tools/generate-audio-v1.py` reproduces these performances without models,
recordings or borrowed compositions. The four score stems form an original
16-bar composition in D minor at 72 BPM. They share one sample-clock transport.

The prior original shipboard synthesis in `generated/` remains **CC0-1.0**.
It is now compressed as Ogg Vorbis without changing the source performances.
Reproduce it with `tools/generate-shipboard-audio-25.py`, then run
`tools/generate-audio-v1.py` to encode its PCM and update its manifest.
Uncompressed intermediates for the new material stay outside the shipped
`public/` directory, on G: by default.

Kenney Sci-Fi Sounds, Impact Sounds and Interface Sounds are **CC0 1.0**.
Their original licence files are `KENNEY-scifi-LICENSE.txt`,
`KENNEY-impact-LICENSE.txt` and `KENNEY-interface-LICENSE.txt`; original URLs
and filenames remain in `sources.json`.

The nine pre-existing `kenney/hardburn-radio-*.ogg` files are original game
dialogue synthesized locally with the installed Windows System.Speech voice
by `tools/radio-calls.ps1`, then filtered and encoded as Vorbis. They are
separate from the Kenney library and are **not identified as CC0 recordings**.
Their existing provenance is documented in `ASSETS.md` under shipboard radio.
This update preserves those files and does not add any third-party dialogue.

All shipped audio is Ogg Vorbis. No game/film soundtrack or recording is used.

Second pass: `naval-v2/` adds original transmitted rail/armour tails, vowel-like
tactical threat bursts, coded critical alarms, three UI cue families and a
fifth synchronized 72 BPM danger score stem. All are **CC0-1.0** deterministic
synthesis from `tools/generate-audio-v2.py`; per-file provenance is in that
folder's `sources.json`. Threat bursts are formant synthesis without words,
voice models or recordings. Tails represent shipboard frame conduction and
filtered tactical monitoring, with no literal atmospheric propagation.

Third pass: `naval-v3/` provides four variants of original energy-weapon
excitation, plasma kick, PDC feed mechanism and guided motor burn, two radio
keying/squelch variants, and a synchronized 72 BPM sparse machinery score.
These **CC0-1.0** assets are reproduced by `tools/generate-audio-v3.py`;
`naval-v3/sources.json` records provenance. `src/audio-acoustics.js` generates
four deterministic, finite shipboard impulse responses at runtime without
recorded spaces or external assets. No voice model or GPU task is used.

Fourth pass: `naval-v4/` replaces combat reports, structural tails, thrust beds,
panel latches/warnings and all six score stems. Original procedural components
are **CC0-1.0**. Brian MacIntosh / BMacZero's real metal impacts are **CC0-1.0**:
https://opengameart.org/content/metal-impact-sounds. Hinchinbrook's Metallic
Groan (official public HQ preview, processed) is **CC0-1.0**:
https://freesound.org/people/hinchinbrook/sounds/496836/.

Real powered hammer, diesel tank, vehicle metal stress and deep explosions
come from the **Sonniss GDC 2020 GameAudio Bundle**. Their original authors
are recorded per source in `naval-v4/sources.json`; these recordings and their
processed derivatives are **not CC0**. The applicable **Sonniss GDC Bundle
EULA v2.0**, downloaded 10 October 2026, permits modification and commercial
finished-game use without attribution: https://sonniss.com/gdc-bundle-license/.
They remain licensed material: no standalone sample-pack redistribution or
AI training/development. Only processed game cues ship; raw packs stay on G:.
The per-file manifest records component provenance and SHA-256 hashes.
`tools/generate-audio-v4.py` reproduces the processing from those raw files.
No television, film or game recording/composition was sampled or copied.

Fifth pass: `naval-v5/` contains six shorter PDC phrases derived only from the
shipped `naval-v4/pdc-*.ogg` performances. It preserves the licensed powered
hammer and CC0 casing layers, reshapes their articulation and finite release,
and introduces no new recordings. These derivatives retain the mixed CC0 /
Sonniss licences above; they are not wholly CC0. `naval-v5/sources.json` records
source-file hashes, recording authors/licences and resulting asset hashes.
`tools/generate-audio-v5.py` reproduces them directly from the committed v4
assets without raw packs, intermediate renders or external downloads.

Sixth pass: `naval-v6/` adds eight performances for each of twenty combat
families, including separate missile/torpedo launch and burn, armour, breach,
interception, ship/reactor explosions and venting. All derive from committed
v4/v5 cues and retain their original mixed CC0/Sonniss licence. No new raw
recordings or downloads are used. Each family varies its actual recorded
layer choices; short PDC accents are baked into one source to avoid stacking.
`naval-v6/sources.json` lists per-performance layer selection, timing, source
hashes, recording authors/licences and resulting hashes. The generator writes
only compressed Ogg game cues, with no intermediate media.

Seventh pass: `naval-v7/` adds eight cold-ejection and eight ignition reports
for each of light swarm, standard missile and heavy torpedo, plus eight swarm
drive-loop textures. These56 compressed performances derive only from the
committed licensed v4/v5 cues above. No new recording, download or raw render
is needed. `naval-v7/sources.json` retains original recording authors/licences
and complete derivation parameters/hashes; mixed Sonniss layers remain
licensed derivatives, not CC0. `tools/generate-audio-v7.py` reproduces them.

notes: Only banks actually referenced by pass-four recipes, loops or tails are included. Unused older preload banks are excluded.
Spatial near/far are source game units; generator converts to centimeters. Non-positional cues use a valid dummy range with attenuation disabled.
radio-intercept is the speech bank; intercept alias is the physical interception impact event.
Runtime aliases identify banks; category/recipe gain, pitch, layered squelch and conditional hull tails remain runtime mixer behavior.
V5 changes only PDC articulation/voice masking. All v4 heavy weapons, master calibration .69 and user preferences retained. Native adapter should mirror pdcPolicy; raw cues retain unity gain.
